name: green-wall-red-disco-girl
image_purpose: summer fashion lookbook and campaign visual

prompt.project_info: Create a modern vibrant outdoor fashion portrait of one consistent adult woman kneeling with a reflective disco ball against a bright green wall.
prompt.main_subject: Adult woman with fair skin, red hair in a high ponytail, sunglasses, and a confident energetic expression. She wears a red swimsuit with white trim and white sneakers, keeping the fashion framing non-sexualized and the outfit unchanged.
composition_elements: Subject kneeling on a concrete surface while holding a reflective silver disco ball.
Bright green wall creates bold contrast with red, silver, and white.
Focus on subject and disco-ball reflections; keep realistic posture and anatomy.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Bright natural sunlight with defined shadows, crisp highlights on the disco ball, modern summer atmosphere, and high-contrast color separation.
prompt.technical_specs: High-resolution photorealistic digital fashion photography, realistic skin, fabric, metal reflections, and hands, sharp focus, clean outdoor composition, no text or watermark.

She kneels on a concrete surface while holding a reflective silver disco ball. She wears a red swimsuit with white trim and white sneakers. A bright green wall behind her creates bold color contrast. Focus on the subject and reflective disco ball, realistic proportions, confident energetic stylish summer mood, high-resolution photorealistic photography, no text, no watermark.
